name: cache-timer
description: Claude Code mod that counts down the prompt cache, shows and sets Claude Code's own idle compaction, and can push a reminder to your phone.

threshold_k.title: Idle-compaction threshold (k tokens)
threshold_k.description: Claude Code's own idle compaction compacts a conversation shortly before its 1-hour cache expires only when the context holds at least this many thousand tokens.

notify.title: Notify before expiry
notify.description: Send a push notification shortly before a 1-hour cache expires.

notify_lead_minutes.title: Notification lead time (minutes)
notify_lead_minutes.description: How many minutes before a 1-hour cache expires to send the notification.

cache_ttl.title: Cache lifetime
cache_ttl.description: auto infers 5m or 1h from cache hits; 5m or 1h pins it.
